name: Currents
description: Brings AIOMetadata catalogs into your Jellyfin library as real titles and plays them through AIOStreams.

versions.changelog: Extras: skip-intro and credits markers (TheIntroDB, AniSkip, PublicMetaDB) offered only on versions of the right length; optional Jellyfin collections per catalog; Verify library, Purge Currents content and Clear stream cache tasks; a guard for untested Jellyfin versions; a diagnostics panel with connection tests.

Media: full track lists before playback (RemuxDB and AIOStreams media info); track choices that play the chosen track; probe results kept across restarts; stream subtitles and AIOStreams subtitle search; YouTube trailers; streams that need request headers.
Fix: a catalog sync no longer forgets search-added titles, or rewrites search-added series into a local folder, while the Currents library folder is on an unmounted share.

Search auto-add: Jellyfin search also lists AIOMetadata titles that are not in the library yet, and opening one adds it and shows the real item. Per-user search switch (admin off, self-service, default). Search-added series get new episodes on catalog sync. AIOMetadata responses are now size-capped.
Per-user versions: every AIOStreams stream appears in Jellyfin's Version menu, ranked by each user's preferences. Self-service page at /Currents/user; admin per-user overrides.

First preview (M1). Syncs AIOMetadata catalogs into Jellyfin libraries as .strm/.nfo titles and plays them through AIOStreams using the admin's default config. Per-user versions arrive in a later release.
